title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00030 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:

01:00 - 01:30: Tagged cement at 2768m w/ 10t, released spear by rotating 2x turns clockwise and observed torque dropped to 6knm then increased to 9knm. Observed hook load dropped to 90t. RIH slowly and located top of 7in tubing 7m lower or at 2775m. Set down 10t to repeat tagging of the cement

sections.text: M/u TDS and pumped w/ 400 l/min 3. 5 bar, 550 l/m 5 bar. Up/down weights 202t/126t. Washed down w/ 550 l/min from 2712m to 2768m

Tagged cement at 2768m w/ 10t, released spear by rotating 2x turns clockwise and observed torque dropped to 6knm then increased to 9knm. Observed hook load dropped to 90t. RIH slowly and located top of 7in tubing 7m lower or at 2775m. Set down 10t to repeat tagging of the cement
Dropped drift and POOH w/ spear on 5,5in DP from 899 m to surface. Avg. Tripping speed 730 m/hr retrieved drift
Pulled spear on surface. Inspected same, OK
Removed ps21s and installed master bushings
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u MS-T seal retrieval tool
M/u MS-T seal retrieval tool to 1x joint and 1x pup joint of 5,5in DP
Pulled MS-T seal retrieval tool to surface and connected control lines, function tested tool
RIH w/ MS-T seal retrieval tool and positioned tool stem in correct space out. Meanwhile bled off 5 bar from b-annulus.
Turned string counter clockwise using chain tongs, only able to get 1x turn. Backed out and attempted again, 1x turn only. Tried to turn w/ iron roughneck, no go
POOH and inspected tool, no damage found, observed some minor scratches
L/d MS-T seal retrieval tool on HTS
P/u and m/u jetting tool assembly to 5,5in DP stand
Jetted WH area with 2200 l/min 60bar 10 RPM
L/d wash tool and r/b DP stand
P/u MS-T retrieval tool assy
RIH with MS-T seal retrieval tool. Rotated tool 4x turns counter clockwise to engage tool to seal. Released seal assembly w/ 80t overpull
POOH w/ MS-T seal retrieval tool, removed seal assy. Disconnected control lines. L/d tool and landing string
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u cutter BHA
P/u premade cutter BHA m/u to 5,5in DP and RIH to cutting depth of 124m
M/u TDS to string, checked and verified depth, filled pipe. Established parameters. 300 l/min 30bar, 500l/min 83bar, 100rpm, 1-5 KNM off), weights 73t up, 69t down, 70t rotation
Cut 10 3/4in surface tie-back at 124m. 80rpm, 300 l/min 30bar. Observed shock on surface indicating successful cut
POOH w/ cutter BHA to surface and l/d same
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Serviced drilling equipment
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u spear assembly
P/u spear assembly from derrick, checked and serviced same
RIH and latched on to 10 3/4in tie-back. Pulled free same w/ 8t overpull
R/u casing tong for 10 3/4in CSG
Set slips on fish and released spear. R/b spear in derrick
Changed to bx3 elevators
Installed elevator on hanger. Broke off and l/d same
POOH 10 3/4in CSG tie-back from 104m to surface
R/d casing tong. Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u torque tool BHA
P/u and m/u torque tool to 3m. Removed FOSV from swedge
P/u 1x stand of 5,5in HWDP and m/u to x-over, RIH w/ 5,5in HWDP from 3m to 117m. Torqued all connections to 67500 KNM
M/u TDS to 5,5in DP, RIH to 140m, started pumping with 1450 l/m, rotated w/ 10rpm. Jetted tie-back adapter area

Stopped pumping and engaged to tie-back adapter at 141,5m. Attempted to back out tie back adapter with 30k KNM, string backed out at saver sub. M/u saver sub to 50 KNM. Tried to break again up 40knm, something broke below rotary table, after 2 turns measured distance travelled up of string Continued turning out further 4 turns, distance travelled further Assumed as good indication of tie back adapter loose.
